meta.answer: Basic has a $0 monthly fee and no minimum balance. Some services can still cost extra, including out-of-network ATM withdrawals ($2.50 each), foreign transactions (3%), card replacement ($5), and expedited card shipping ($25).
Premium costs $15.00 per month and includes a metal debit card.
Your upgrade takes effect immediately, and you’re charged Premium’s full monthly fee that day from your main balance. That day becomes your new billing date.
The help-center information doesn’t say whether Premium plan fees can be refunded. Message support to ask about your situation.
If your balance is too low on the billing date, Tallowbrook tries to collect the plan fee again after 3 days. If that attempt also fails, your plan moves to Basic. Cushion doesn’t cover plan fees.
No. Monthly plan fees aren’t eligible for goodwill refunds. Outside the cooling-off period, they also aren’t refunded or prorated.
Yes. Plus now costs $5.00 per month. The help-center excerpts don’t state what the Plus monthly fee used to be.
Plus includes 3 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month. After that, each withdrawal costs $2.50.
No. Premium has no Tallowbrook fee for using another bank’s ATM in the US or abroad. The ATM owner may charge a surcharge, which Premium reimburses up to $10 per calendar month.
On Basic, replacing your card costs $5. Expedited shipping adds $25, so the total is $30; standard shipping is free and takes 7 to 10 business days.
No. On Plus, the replacement card is free, and standard shipping is free. Expedited shipping costs $25.00 if you choose it.

The Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount in US dollars. It applies to purchases in foreign currency and to US-dollar purchases processed by a merchant outside the US; it does not apply to ATM withdrawals abroad.
No. The foreign transaction fee applies to purchases, not ATM withdrawals abroad. International ATM fees may apply instead, depending on your plan.
A domestic wire costs $25 on Basic, $15 on Plus, and is free on Premium.
No. International wires can’t be sent from a Basic account; you’ll need to move to Plus or Premium. You can still receive international wires on Basic.
Incoming domestic wires are free on every plan. Incoming international wires are $10 on Basic and Plus, and free on Premium.
A cash deposit at a participating store costs $3 on the Plus plan. [fees-all-v2]
Tallowbrook doesn’t charge a fee for returned transfers, and it has no inactivity fees on any plan. The other bank may charge a fee for a returned transfer.

Support can refund one fee of up to $25 as a goodwill courtesy in any rolling 12-month period. If the ATM fee refunded in May was a goodwill refund and it was within the last 12 months, they can’t refund another one as goodwill; fees charged in error are handled separately and aren’t subject to that limit.

Right—Premium has a $0 out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee, so Tallowbrook should not charge you that fee. The ATM owner may still add a separate surcharge; Premium reimburses those surcharges up to $10 per calendar month. Check whether the charge is labeled “Out-of-network ATM fee” or is part of the ATM withdrawal total.
The daily card spending limits are $3,000 on Basic, $5,000 on Plus, and $10,000 on Premium.

In the app, tap **Cards** > **Activate card**, then scan your card or enter its last four digits and expiry date. Set your PIN when prompted; activation is instant, and you can use the card right after.

Standard card delivery takes 7–10 business days, while expedited delivery takes 2–3 business days. The help-center excerpt doesn’t include the instructions for what to do if a card hasn’t arrived, so I can’t confirm the next step.
Standard card delivery takes 7 to 10 business days. Weekends and bank holidays don’t count as business days.

Freezing your card is temporary and reversible, and it stops new purchases. Reporting it lost or stolen cancels it permanently, can’t be undone, and lets you order a replacement; if you’re sure it’s gone or stolen, report it rather than just freezing it.
Yes. Freezing your card does not stop recurring payments to merchants you’ve already authorized, such as Netflix. To stop future subscription charges, cancel with the merchant.

In the app, tap **Cards** and switch **Freeze card** on to stop new purchases. If you can’t find the card, tap **Report lost or stolen**; this cancels it permanently and can’t be undone. You can create a virtual card in the app and use it online and in mobile wallets while you wait.

Yes. Every verified member can create one virtual card in the app, and it works right away for online purchases and in mobile wallets while your physical replacement is on its way. It has its own number, so it’s separate from your physical card.
No. Reporting your card as damaged doesn’t cancel it, so you can keep using it if it still works. It stops working when you activate the replacement.
We mail your renewal card automatically about 30 days before your current card expires. It keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code.
In the app, tap **Cards**, choose your card, then tap **Controls**. Switch off **International purchases**; the change takes effect straight away.

“Locked by Tallowbrook” means a fraud lock, which is different from a freeze, so the freeze toggle can’t remove it. If there’s an open fraud alert in the app, answer it; otherwise, message Support in the app so they can pass your case to the Fraud team. The Fraud team replies within 2 business days, often sooner.
No. Your metal card keeps working until it expires. After it expires, or if you need a replacement, you’ll get a plastic card.

The help center says cards are sent to the address on file, but it doesn’t say whether you can use an office address. Update your address before ordering a replacement; a card that has already been mailed can’t be redirected. For help, contact support in the app.
On Basic, replacing a lost card costs $5.00. Standard shipping is free and takes 7 to 10 business days.
In the app, tap **Cash**, then **ATM map** to see nearby BrookLink ATMs and their opening hours.

No. On Basic, your daily ATM withdrawal limit is $500, and support can’t raise it for today or make an exception. The limit resets at midnight Eastern Time; changing plans is the only way to get a higher limit.

If the withdrawal is still pending, wait until it posts; pending withdrawals can’t be disputed. Check the app first, since the ATM may reverse it automatically within a few days. If the charge is still there after it posts, open a dispute in the app within 60 days: tap the transaction, then **Get help** → **Cash not dispensed**. Most ATM cases are resolved within 10 business days, and if the records show cash wasn’t dispensed, we credit the full amount, including any ATM fee we charged.
No. BrookLink ATMs don’t accept cash deposits; use a participating retail store to add cash instead.

Those are two different charges: the ATM owner sets its surcharge, which is shown before you confirm, and Tallowbrook’s out-of-network fee appears separately in your activity. Use a BrookLink ATM to avoid both charges. Premium reimburses ATM-owner surcharges up to $10 per calendar month, but that does not change the ATM owner’s charge at the time of withdrawal.
Premium reimburses ATM owner surcharges up to $10 per month. The refund is credited automatically on the first business day of the following month.

No. Tallowbrook retired travel notices, so you don’t need to notify us before going to Mexico. Check that International purchases is switched on under Cards, then Controls, and keep app notifications on for fraud alerts.

We convert foreign-currency purchases using the card network’s exchange rate on the day the transaction settles, with no markup. The final amount may differ slightly from the pending estimate because the rate can change before settlement.

The pending amount is an estimate based on the exchange rate when you paid. After the purchase settles, the final amount uses the card network’s rate on the settlement day, so it can change. Your plan’s foreign transaction fee may also be added: Basic 3%, Plus 1%, or Premium 0%.

Yes. As a Premium member, you can request an emergency card delivered to where you’re staying in Japan; it arrives within 3 business days and costs nothing. Freeze or report your card in the app, then message support with the full address where you’ll be staying.

No. Your Tallowbrook card works in most countries where Visa is accepted, but cards don’t work in comprehensively sanctioned countries and regions. International purchases must also be switched on in your card controls.
No, you don’t need to tell us before traveling; travel notices have been retired. Plus has a 2% foreign transaction fee on purchases abroad, so purchases in Canada are subject to that fee.
ACH transfers submitted before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day. Transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, on weekends, or on bank holidays are sent the next business day.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Linked accounts → Add account**, choose your bank, and sign in to link it instantly. If your bank isn’t listed, enter its routing and account numbers; we’ll send two small deposits in 1–2 business days, and you’ll need to enter their amounts in the app within 14 days. The external account must be in your name.
No. You need to enter the two test-deposit amounts within 14 days; after that, the link expires and you’ll need to start again.

No. The external bank account must be in your name, and Tallowbrook can’t link an account belonging to someone else, including a spouse. You can send her money with BrookPay: one person pays and the other sends their share from the app, with no fee and arrival in seconds.

BrookPay payments can’t be cancelled or reversed, even by support. Ask the recipient to send the money back; if you think it was a scam, report it to us right away and our Fraud team will try to recover it, but we can’t guarantee recovery.
Yes. You can cancel a scheduled ACH transfer in the app any time before the 4:00 PM ET cutoff on its send date. After the cutoff, it’s already on its way and can’t be cancelled.
For 24 hours after your first sign-in on a new device, BrookPay and transfers to external accounts are limited to $500 in total. The limit ends automatically, and support can’t lift it early.
No. Once a wire has been sent, it can’t be cancelled. We can ask the receiving bank to return the money, but the bank decides and a return isn’t guaranteed.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Direct deposit → Set up automatically**, then find your employer or payroll provider and sign in. Or download the pre-filled form from that screen, or copy your routing and account numbers, and give them to your employer. It usually takes one or two pay cycles for the change to take effect.

You can get your paycheck up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday. The timing depends on when your employer sends the payroll file, so you might be paid one day early or on payday instead.
On Plus, you can deposit up to $2,500 by mobile check per day.

After an accepted check deposit, the first $225 is available the next business day, and the rest is available within 2 business days. If your account has been open for less than 30 days, or the check meets certain conditions, the hold may be longer; the app shows the release date.
Sign the back of the check, then write “For mobile deposit only at Tallowbrook” under your signature.
No. ACH only processes on business days, so a transfer submitted on Saturday is sent the next business day. Once sent, it usually arrives in 1 to 3 business days.
The Premium monthly ACH transfer-out limit is $50,000 per calendar month. It resets on the first day of each month at midnight Eastern Time.

Basic allows up to $2,500 in ACH transfers out per day, so you can’t send $4,000 by ACH in one day. ACH transfers submitted before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day; after that, or on weekends or bank holidays, they’re sent the next business day.
No. If your balance is too low on the send date, the recurring transfer is skipped and isn’t retried. Future transfers in the series will still run, and there’s no fee.

Give the sender your full legal name and address, routing number, and account number from the app under Account details → Wire instructions. For an international wire, they’ll also need Tallowbrook’s SWIFT code, shown on that same screen.

Freeze the card used or report it lost or stolen before opening the dispute; freezing is enough if you still have the card. Report the transaction within 60 days of the statement date it first appeared on. In the app, confirm you didn’t make or authorize it and that your card is frozen or reported, then open the dispute.
For a jacket you paid for but never received, file a merchant dispute within 120 days. Try contacting the merchant first and keep a record of the conversation.

You may be able to file a merchant dispute if you paid by card and the item was significantly different from its description. Try contacting the seller first and keep a record of your emails; a dispute can’t guarantee a refund. The help-center excerpt doesn’t specify whether a broken item qualifies or give the filing deadline.

If your dispute passes the initial review, you’ll get a provisional credit within 10 business days of filing. Most disputes are resolved within 45 days; foreign transactions and accounts open less than 30 days can take up to 90 days. If the dispute is denied, we take the provisional credit back 5 business days after sending you written notice.
No. We send you a written explanation first, then take back the provisional credit 5 business days after that notice. If this makes your balance negative, you’ll need to add money.
No. You can dispute a transaction only after it posts; pending authorizations can still change or disappear. Most post or drop off within 7 days, and the Dispute option appears once it posts.

A pending hotel charge is usually a temporary authorization; it often drops off within 7 days, and you can’t dispute it while it’s pending. Wait to see whether it posts or disappears. If both charges post, contact the hotel first; if they don’t help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate.

Report the unauthorized ACH debit within 60 days of the statement it first appeared on. In the app, tap the transaction, then **Get help**, then **I didn’t authorize this**. We’ll ask the company’s bank to return the money; if your claim passes an initial review, you’ll get a provisional credit within 10 business days.
No. Support can open disputes totaling up to $5,000 per case; a $7,200 dispute goes to the Disputes team, who will contact you within 2 business days.
Upload the order confirmation showing the expected delivery date, any tracking information, and your messages to the merchant asking about delivery. Photos and PDFs are accepted.
Withdraw the dispute from its case page so you aren’t credited twice. If you were credited twice, contact support in the app.
No—this is a scam. Tallowbrook will never ask you to read out a one-time code; hang up and open the app yourself to message support if needed.

If you don’t respond within 24 hours, your card stays locked until you contact Tallowbrook. If you later answer “Yes, that was me,” the card is unlocked straight away; if you have no open alert, message support in the app.
The one-time sign-in code sent by text is valid for 10 minutes.
The reset link expires after one hour. If it has expired, start the password reset again from the sign-in screen by tapping “Forgot password.”

If someone uses your card without your authorization, you can dispute the transaction. Freeze or report the card lost or stolen first, and report the transaction within 60 days of the statement date it first appeared on.
No. A real fraud text only asks you to reply YES or NO and never includes a link. Don’t click it; open the Tallowbrook app to check the alert.

No. Tallowbrook charges $0 overdraft fees and $0 non-sufficient funds fees on every plan. If you don’t have enough money, a transaction is generally declined without a fee; a balance can rarely go negative in certain situations.
On Premium, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $200 below zero, with no fee. You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days to use it.

You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days and must be on Plus or Premium; Cushion isn’t available on Basic. Turn it on in the app under Profile, then Cushion. If your direct deposits later fall below the requirement, Cushion pauses until you qualify again.
No. Cushion covers debit card purchases, not ATM withdrawals. Cash withdrawals are never covered by Cushion.

Incoming money automatically goes toward your negative balance first, and you can also add money yourself. If you stay negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended; after 60 days, your account is restricted so you can add money but can’t spend or send until it’s repaid. There are no fees or interest for using Cushion or repaying late.
On Premium, Savings Pockets earn 3.75% APY on combined balances up to $100,000; amounts above that earn 0.10% APY. The rate is effective June 1, 2026, and is variable.
Plus Savings Pockets earn 2.00% APY on combined pocket balances up to $100,000; balances above that earn 0.10% APY. The Plus rate took effect June 1, 2026.
Your Basic Savings Pockets now earn 0.50% APY. The rate changed on June 1, 2026; before then, it was 0.75%.
Savings interest is paid monthly, on the first business day of the next month, and appears as “Interest.”
You can have up to 10 Savings Pockets, each with its own name and goal.
No. There’s no limit on how many times you can withdraw from a Savings Pocket, and moving money to your main balance is instant and free.

If you earned less than $10.00 in interest for the year, Tallowbrook won’t send a Form 1099-INT. Your interest still appears on your monthly statements, and you may still need to report it; the help center can’t give tax advice.
Yes. We email members at least 30 days before lowering a savings rate.

You can close your account in the app: tap **Profile**, then **Close account**, review where any remaining money will go, and confirm. Before closing, make sure there are no pending transactions or open disputes, your balance isn’t negative, and you’ve moved money out of Savings Pockets and switched your direct deposit and automatic payments. Support can also close it if your balance is $0.00 and those requirements are met.

If you have a linked external account in your name, Tallowbrook sends your remaining balance there by ACH. Otherwise, it mails a check to the address on your profile. The payout is sent within 10 business days of closing.
No. Closed accounts can’t be reopened. You can apply for a new account in the app, and you’ll need new account and card numbers and to complete identity checks again.

Tallowbrook may close your account if it has a $0 balance and no activity for 12 months. We’ll email you at least 30 days beforehand, and any activity during that notice period keeps the account open. Accounts with a balance aren’t closed for inactivity, and there’s no inactivity fee on any plan.
No. Plan fees aren’t refunded or prorated when you close your account, including for the month you close it.
Phone support is available every day from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET.
We acknowledge your formal complaint within 2 business days and send a final response within 15 business days. If we need more time, we’ll explain why and tell you when to expect an answer.

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Power of attorney,” or ask your mom to message support from her own session. Send a signed, effective power of attorney document, your government-issued photo ID, and your contact details; Account Services will confirm what they received within 2 business days and may ask for more information. You can’t receive account information or give instructions until Account Services approves the document.

I’m sorry for your loss. Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Bereavement,” or message support; Account Services will handle the case. They’ll ask for the death certificate, proof that you’re the executor or administrator of the estate or next of kin, and your photo ID.
Card refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 business days after the merchant issues them, so three days may be too soon. If it shows as pending, the money is available once it posts.

Support can freeze or unfreeze your card, report it lost or stolen and order a replacement, open eligible disputes up to $5,000, refund fees under the refund policy, change your plan, close an account if its balance is zero and nothing is pending or disputed, and explain fees, limits, and policies. Suspected account takeover, fraud locks, and scam payments go to Fraud; disputes above the support limit go to Disputes; identity checks and restricted accounts go to Verification; power of attorney, deceased-account matters, and financial abuse go to Account Services; and formal complaints go to Complaints. Specialist teams reply within 2 business days.

If it’s safe, message Tallowbrook support in the app; you can use the code phrase “I need to talk about my account security” if someone might see your screen. Support will connect you with the Account Services team, which can discuss ways to keep money safe and won’t tell anyone else you contacted them. If you’re in immediate danger, call emergency services first.

To open a Tallowbrook account, you must be at least 18, live in the US with a US residential address (not a PO box), have a Social Security number or ITIN, and have an unexpired government-issued photo ID and a smartphone that can run the app. Download the app and tap **Get started**; every account starts on Basic, and you can change plans after verification.
Most applications are verified within 1 business day, and many are verified within minutes. If your application needs manual review, it can take up to 5 business days.
You can try up to 3 times total, so after failing twice you have 1 try left. After the third failed attempt, your application is closed and you can apply again after 30 days.
Yes. You can still receive deposits while your account is under review, so your paycheck can be deposited. Depending on the review, other account features may be unavailable.

If we can’t confirm your address automatically, you may be asked to upload a utility bill, lease or mortgage statement, bank or credit card statement, or government letter showing your name and new address. The document must be dated within the last 90 days.
Message Tallowbrook support in the app. They’ll pass your request to the team that verifies your identity, and it may take longer when you’ve lost access to your old number.
Your monthly statement is ready within 3 after the end of each month, and we’ll notify you when it’s available.

No. Tallowbrook offers individual accounts only, not joint accounts or second cardholders. You and your partner can each open your own account and send money to each other instantly for free with BrookPay.
No. Tallowbrook offers personal accounts only, not business checking or other business accounts.
No. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investing or cryptocurrency, so you can’t buy bitcoin in the app.

When a new friend opens a Tallowbrook account using your invite link and receives at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days, you each get $25. Both bonuses are paid within 5 business days after your friend qualifies. Find your link under Profile > Invite friends; it must be used at signup, and a referral can’t be added afterward.
No. Reporting your card stolen cancels it permanently, even if you find it later, so you can’t keep using it. Destroy the canceled card and wait for the replacement.

A damaged-card replacement keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code. Merchants that store your card may need the new expiry date, so check whether your subscriptions need updating.
The help center can’t provide investment advice, including recommendations about which stocks to buy. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investment or brokerage accounts.
The help center can’t advise you on how to report freelance income on your taxes. Please speak with a tax professional.
The help center does not cover the current federal funds rate.
The help center can’t advise whether bitcoin is a good investment. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investment accounts or cryptocurrency, and support can’t advise on investments or crypto.
The Tallowbrook help center doesn’t cover recommendations for travel rewards credit cards.
The help center doesn’t cover translating letters. You can message Tallowbrook support in the app for help.

Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit products, and your account or debit card won’t raise or lower your credit score. We can’t give advice on borrowing or improving your score; the help center doesn’t cover ways to raise it quickly.
The help center does not cover DMV opening hours.
The help center doesn’t cover recommendations for tax accountants. Tallowbrook can’t give tax advice; for help with your situation, speak with a qualified tax professional.
The help center doesn’t cover whether renting or buying is smarter for your situation. Please consult a qualified financial adviser.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer personal loans, so there’s no personal-loan interest rate. Tallowbrook also doesn’t recommend lenders or give borrowing advice.
You can’t send international wires on the Basic plan. They’re available on Plus and Premium.
Cushion isn’t available on Basic, so there’s no Cushion limit. A debit card purchase that would exceed your balance is declined, with no fee.

We don’t charge inactivity fees on any plan; the fee is $0.00. A paid plan’s monthly fee continues while your account is open, even if you don’t use it, so check whether the charge appears as a “Plan fee” in your activity feed.
Plus cards are plastic, not metal. You’d need to upgrade to Premium to get a metal card; you can change plans in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away.
BrookPay is free on every plan, even when you send more than $1,000. Your daily sending limit depends on your plan: $1,000 on Basic, $2,500 on Plus, or $5,000 on Premium.

No. For a card purchase that never arrived, the current merchant-dispute window is 120 days from the transaction date, so 100 days is within the window. Contact the merchant first and keep a record of your messages.

No—the Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount in US dollars, not 1.5%. It applies to foreign-currency purchases and US-dollar purchases processed by a merchant outside the US; it does not apply to ATM withdrawals abroad.
No. Early direct deposit can make your paycheck available up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday, depending on when your employer sends the payroll file.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit cards; your Tallowbrook card is a debit card that uses money already in your account. So you can’t move money from a Tallowbrook credit card to checking.
You can deposit cash at participating retail stores, but the help center doesn’t list which stores participate. BrookLink ATMs don’t accept cash deposits.
The help center doesn’t say how many BrookLink ATMs are in Ohio. You can find nearby BrookLink ATMs in the app under Cash, then ATM map.
Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received and may ask for more information. The help center doesn’t specify how long approval itself takes.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can choose a custom design for your Premium metal card.
The help-center information doesn’t specify a cap on the number of friends you can refer. It says each qualifying friend earns you both a $25 bonus.
The help center excerpts don’t state the Premium savings APY for 2024, so I can’t confirm it.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can set a spending limit just for restaurants. It says card controls don’t change your limits, but doesn’t describe a restaurant-specific spending limit.

The help center doesn’t specify how long it takes to pay the balance to the estate. Account Services will contact you within 2 business days, and the balance is paid after they confirm who’s authorized.

The help center doesn’t provide a direct phone number for the Fraud team. Use the contact details in the app or on the help center; you can message support in the app any time, and specialist teams reply within 2 business days.
The help center doesn’t say whether statements are available in Spanish.
